interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking/roadway area around the tree to provide a continuous, ADA-compliant clear walking width.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Paving
interventions.description: Carry the sidewalk material and level across the driveway to reinforce pedestrian priority and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps to ensure the sidewalk is accessible to all users.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk / Raised Crossing
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk material across the driveway at a level grade to reinforce pedestrian priority and slow entering/exiting vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Add zebra or ladder style markings across the driveway entrance to clearly define the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Clear Pedestrian Path
interventions.description: Establish and enforce a clear pedestrian zone on the sidewalk that is free of furniture and obstructions to ensure safe passage.

interventions.title: Protective Bollards or Planters
interventions.description: Install physical barriers along the curb line to protect the outdoor dining area and pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Warning Signage
interventions.description: Install signs warning both drivers and pedestrians of the tram tracks and potential crossing activity.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk to provide a designated and safer crossing point, especially given the institutional land use.
